exercise.title: Notes on the low E and A strings
exercise.why: Em is named after the note of the open low E string and Am after the open A string, so the names on these two strings are where chord names come from.

cells.text:
Press Start in the game below. The game names a note and a string: tap that note on the neck, then play it on your guitar and say its name out loud.
The game stays on the low E and A strings, up to the 5th fret. Practice until a few of the names come without counting up from the open string.

Press Start in the game below. Now the game lights a note on the neck: press its name under the neck.
Play the note on your guitar as you answer, so your hand learns the place while your eyes learn the name.
